notes.title: Zipple World 2: The sweet chaos - important gameplay update!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
the gameplay has been updated.

[h1]Collecting items to give commands to frogs[/h1]
Every time you kill an enemy, you create a magic item NECESSARY to move the little frogs to save.
The icon at the bottom right during the game shows the number of items collected.
You can also kill enemies by jumping on them.
To catch the "magic boxes" just touch it to activate the elastic to the protagonist; then you have to drag these objects (with the label "TAKE") in the houses of the village (label "HOME") or to little frogs.
Every time you move the small frogs (mouse double click) you will spend ONE magical item in the basket.
To move the "frogs-objectives" just double-click on a point to activate the direction "HERE"; then you have to drag these companions in the houses of the village (label "HOME").
If you have NO items collected, you can not control the little frogs.
[b]In this way you have to go hunting for enemies to be able to move the small frogs![/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25086862/43642743249a299c9eadd753563be147c9588737.jpg[/img]

[h1]New 'magic food items'[/h1]
Each type of enemy killed will create a different kind of 'magic item', with different scores.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11606299/66e33081bf7f13cd002df2708534ddc5598f5a1f.jpg[/img]

[h1]Number of enemies[/h1]
The number of enemies in the scene has been balanced, and probably in the future we will improve the comprehensive management of the enemies.

Let's keep in touch for future updates!

in this summer we have completed the mega-update for the game!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fw7jZDOsW28
[b]Changes list:[/b]

    -Falling rocks and bonuses only from level 20
    -Improved camera view
    -Improved gameplay visibility
    -New indicators
    -Zipple's story description
    -Improved mission summary
    -Added the Shaman's house for addictional points (on mission completed)
    -New 'magic food objects' management

[b]Now remember that magical objects appear every enemy explosion and you can bring them to small frogs or in the houses of the village to take a lot of points![/b]

notes.title: And now are ready also the multiple public rankings and lastest game optimizations!
notes.content:
Four public leaderboards are available now!
[b]
- Highscores (total score)
- Level Reached (the level achieved)
- Enemies killed (number of killed enemies)
- Frogs saved (the number of small frogs saved)
[/b]

In this way, the challenge between players in order to be [b]#1[/b] is even more exciting!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25086862/4de64da36a539d7ef8934887294238f9de6a10c1.png[/img]

[b]Zipple World 2 - The sweet chaos[/b] is an entirely new game designed to provide a different enjoyment to players while maintaining the style and the world of Zipple!
[b]
New features:

- New missions and objectives: this time the little frog will guide and save the comrades to overcome levels.
- New control and pointing system with the mouse.
- More freedom of movement, run and exploration.
- Protection and rescue of the little frogs to save.
- New scenarios and random platforms.
- New procedural dynamics.
[/b]

Have also been conserved bonuses and items to be saved in the first chapter!
[b]Zipple World 1 and 2 are two parallel games designed to offer a wider and different entertainment to players according to the different tastes, with the competition of real-time leaderboards online![/b]
[b]
Possible updates:

- New scenery pack
- New enemies pack
- Full controller support
- New obstacles pack
[/b]

ENJOY !!

[img]http://media.indiedb.com/images/games/1/51/50035/new_logo.2.png[/img]
